description: Let \(M\) be a nonempty structure and \(p(\bar x)\) a collection of formulas using old-element names from \(M\). If every finite subset is realized in \(M\), there exist a nonempty structure \(N\), an elementary embedding \(f:M\to N\), and a tuple \(\bar b\) satisfying all of \(p\) with each old name \(a\) interpreted by that same specified \(f(a)\).
